context: Outside the koban. Hina has been "playing with the fountain pen she found." Officer Takeda is on patrol and is the only adult around.
purpose: gentle authority + kid logic — officer doing the smallest possible enforcement

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こんにちは。それ、見せてもらえる？
lines.en: Hello there. Can you let me see that?
lines.style: Crouches down to her level in the voice. Calm, low, friendly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Holds it up proudly. Eight-year-old certainty about finder rights.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そっか。本当に拾ったの？落とした人、いるかも。
lines.en: I see. Really, you found it? Someone might have dropped it.
lines.style: No accusation. Plants the seed gently.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A small reality-check. Voice loses half its certainty.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: じゃあ、一緒に交番に預けようか。
lines.en: Then — shall we hand it in at the koban, together?
lines.style: Hand offered in the voice. Not taking it from her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Half-protest, half-already-knowing. Pout in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 届けたら、もしかして、ありがとうって言ってくれる人いるかも。
lines.en: If you turn it in, someone might come thank you, you know.
lines.style: Pitches it as a small adventure.
